instruction: Workshop with office shell. The Desktop contains an editable IFC4 seed file at /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc. Open that seed project in Bonsai with the IFC project open controls, inspect it as needed. The seed contains placeholder space names and no final window objects. In Bonsai/Blender, rename the spaces to the required room names and add the required window objects, then save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc using Bonsai's IFC save/export controls. The saved IFC should contain a one-storey workshop shell with a small office, WC, and storage room. The building should be a rectangular single-storey shell about 12 m by 7 m with walls about 3.2 m high and one floor slab. It must contain real IfcSpace objects named Workshop, Office, WC, Store. It must include at least 8 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, at least 1 IfcSlab, at least 4 IfcDoor elements, and at least 5 IfcWindow elements. Use real IFC/BIM elements rather than ordinary Blender mesh placeholders or visual-only geometry. The exported IFC should use the IFC4 schema and have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching the shell, with X span about 12 m, Y span about 7 m, and Z span about 3.2 m. Other coordinates, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, object type names, relationship nesting, property sets, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved IFC satisfies these requirements.
